title: OmniSpec Project Manifest
description: Machine-readable state machine tracking the active specification, project configuration, and spec history for an OmniSpec-enabled repository.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest structure revision. Bumped on breaking schema changes.

version.description: OmniSpec CLI version this project is synchronized with.

profile.description: Domain regulatory profile (general, fintech, healthtech, bpo, ecommerce).

stack.description: Detected or declared primary technology stack.

documentationStandard.description: Documentation standard enforced by CONSTITUTION.md (e.g. TSDoc, JSDoc).

qualityGates.description: Commands (newline separated) that must pass before a task is considered complete.

agent.description: Selected adapters (comma-separated): antigravity, cursor, claude, copilot, kilo, opencode, gemini, codex, generic; all selects concrete adapters. Invocation syntax depends on the host.

language.description: Installation UI language; does not classify user experience or select application technologies.

ui.description: Configured UI component kit and design companion for frontend tasks.

components.description: Primary UI component kit detected or selected for frontend composition.

active_spec.description: Slug of the currently focused specification, or null when none is active.

active_archetype.description: Archetype type of the active specification (feature, bugfix, debt, rfc).

specs.description: Chronological registry of every specification created in this project.

branch.description: Assigned Git branch for the specification work.
